periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axis angled approximately 30 degrees downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology where the horizontal width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward taper visible with the patch reaching its lowest point well below the horizontal midline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with minimal indentation along the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band occupying approximately 30% of the visible dorsal-to-caudal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide cranial separation between the dark pinnae regions, roughly equal to the transverse width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded convex curvature at the superior boundaries of the pinnae.
